Scentspired is an independent fragrance brand. All products sold by Scentspired are original creations, developed and manufactured independently.

Any references on this website to fragrance styles, scent profiles, or well-known perfume houses are made solely for descriptive and comparative purposes. Such references are intended to help customers understand the character of a fragrance and should never be interpreted as implying identity, equivalence, endorsement, sponsorship, or affiliation with any designer, luxury, niche, or high-street brand.

Scentspired fragrances are inspired interpretations only. They are not replicas, copies, or clones, and are not to be confused with original fragrances produced by other brands.

All product names, brand names, trademarks, trade dress, and copyrights mentioned or implied on this website are the property of their respective owners. The use of any such names or marks does not indicate any relationship, partnership, or approval between Scentspired and the trademark owner.

Scentspired is not affiliated with, endorsed by, authorised by, licensed by, or connected in any way with any designer brand, perfume house, or manufacturer whose trademarks may be referenced. Trademark owners do not sponsor, authorise, promote, or represent Scentspired or its products.

All references are made in good faith and in accordance with applicable laws governing comparative and descriptive advertising, including fair-use principles. Customers should not expect Scentspired products to be identical to any other fragrance.
